lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized in a multi-row horizontal grid posterior to the gill slits, with a higher spatial density of smaller clusters near the head transitioning to larger, more widely spaced clusters toward the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a series of grid-like nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient (high intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow on the ventral-facing edge) running parallel to the main body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, discrete high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily in the lower-medial section of the fin's visible mask.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish (remoras) are visible: a cluster associated with the ventral surface of the pectoral fin and two individuals trailing beneath the mid-section.
